scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Friday’s lantern-walk prop plan from risking damage to a borrowed paper parasol.
Emerging Need: A dry decorative idea becomes concerning only after a specific trunk item is named and rain enters the walk forecast before prop check.
Decision Context: Messages, calendar, and crew email establish the outing, intended item, weather, and swap cutoff; the lending record supplies the wet-weather limit.
Consequence: Timely warning can prevent the parasol’s first wet exposure while preserving the outing. After rain has marked the paper, that initial damage cannot be prevented, although keeping it dry can still limit further harm.

parameter.subject: Friday lantern walk: dry-weather prop notes
parameter.body: Thanks for keeping Friday's Faubourg lantern walk on your radar. The crew expects a dry evening and welcomes hand-carried shade props or paper pieces for the brass-corner photos. Final staging details will follow midweek.

parameter.title: Faubourg lantern walk with Darius
parameter.description: Meet from Lucia's porch, then walk toward the brass corner; colorful hand-carried props welcome if weather holds.
parameter.location: Tremé porch to Faubourg Marigny route

parameter.content: For Friday, I’m planning to pick up the scarlet paper parasol from your front-room trunk Thursday evening. It will look sharp over the brass corner photos.

parameter.subject: Lantern walk weather and prop-check update
parameter.body: Updated route notes: light rain or mist is now likely Friday evening. If you are exchanging fragile props for wet-weather gear, finalize changes before 14:00 Friday. Prop-bag check starts at 15:00; checked bags move to the lead van and cannot be swapped after tagging.

parameter.content: I’m past prop check now. The scarlet parasol is tagged in the lead-van bag with the other brass-corner pieces.

The first brass-corner photo just finished in the drizzle. The scarlet paper parasol was opened for it; the paper has visible wet spots and a seam has started to ripple. I have moved under the awning with it.
